meta.name: container-platforms
meta.description: Use for Docker, BuildKit, Podman, Compose, OCI image builds, runtime behavior, registries, multi-stage Dockerfiles, image optimization, healthchecks, non-root execution, supply chain safety, and container troubleshooting.

copy.tagline: 构建优化容器镜像并排查运行故障
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要管理Docker镜像并解决容器运行问题。
copy.tagline_en: Build, optimize, and troubleshoot container images and runtimes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage Docker images and fix container runtime issues.

howto.what: Claude 会按既定流程设计并检查容器镜像和运行配置,包括 Dockerfile、Compose、镜像优化等;并输出配置改动、构建命令、验证与安全说明。
howto.when: 当你说到 Docker 等容器平台,或要求构建镜像、排查容器问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 Python 应用的多阶段 Dockerfile
say.note: 会生成含构建与运行阶段的 Dockerfile。

say.text: 检查一下这个 compose 文件有什么问题
say.note: 会逐项审查并给出修改建议。

say.text: 让容器不用 root 运行,该改哪里?
say.note: 会调整用户模型和文件权限。

howto.what_en: Claude follows a defined workflow to design and review container images and runtime configs, including Dockerfile, Compose, image optimization, etc.; it outputs config changes, build/run commands, and validation notes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention container platforms like Docker, or ask about building images or troubleshooting containers.

say_en.text: Write a multi-stage Dockerfile for a Python app.
say_en.note: Generates a Dockerfile with build and run stages.

say_en.text: Check this compose file for problems.
say_en.note: Reviews the file and suggests fixes.

say_en.text: How do I run the container as a non-root user?
say_en.note: Adjusts user model and file ownership.
